name: feature
description: Plan a feature, build it, review the change, and fix what the review found

steps.title: Plan it
steps.prompt:
Plan this feature without changing any file: {goal}

Read the code it touches. Answer with the files to change, the order, the tests that prove it works, and the risks. Keep it short enough for the next worker to follow.

steps.title: Build it
steps.prompt:
Build this feature, following the plan below: {goal}

Add or update the tests the plan names and run them before you stop.

steps.title: Review the change
steps.prompt:
Review, without changing any file, the change the step before made for: {goal}

Read what the workflow changed so far (the diff is named below). List each real problem with its file and line: bugs, missing tests, broken behaviour. Say plainly when there is none.

steps.title: Fix what the review found
steps.prompt:
Fix every problem the review below found in the change for: {goal}

If the review found none, run the tests and stop. Run the tests before you stop.
